    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersBoomstick mini sausage rollsFlaky pastry rolls of pork, fennel and sage sausage meat, brushed with egg and sesame, with tomato relishHow to make it3 sheets of frozen puff pastry, thawed500g pork sausage mince1 small onion, grated1 tsp fennel seeds, crushed6 sage leaves, chopped50g breadcrumbs1/4 tsp black pepper1 egg, beaten1 tbsp sesame seeds125ml tomato relishHeat the oven to 210°C and line two trays.Mix 500g pork sausage mince with the grated onion, crushed fennel, sage, breadcrumbs and pepper.Halve each pastry sheet, lay a line of filling along one long edge, roll up and seal with beaten egg.Cut into 4cm lengths, brush with egg, sprinkle with sesame seeds and snip a small slash in each top.Bake until puffed, golden and cooked through.Serve warm with the tomato relish.Skeleton army garlic bread bonesSoft pizza dough knotted into bone shapes, brushed with garlic and parsley butter and parmesanHow to make it500g pizza dough1 tbsp plain flour60g butter, melted3 garlic cloves, crushed2 tbsp parsley, chopped1/2 tsp sea salt flakes30g parmesan, finely gratedHeat the oven to 220°C and line two trays.On a lightly floured bench, divide the dough into 12, roll each into a 20cm rope and tie a loose knot at each end so it looks like a bone.Lay on the trays and leave to rise a little.Mix the butter, garlic and parsley and brush half over the bones.Bake until golden.Brush with the rest of the garlic butter and sprinkle with the salt and parmesan.MainsLord Arthur's castle roast chickenWhole chicken roasted with honey, thyme and garlic over carrots, parsnips and onions, with pan gravyHow to make it1.8kg whole chicken40g butter, soft1 tbsp thyme leaves1 1/2 tsp salt1/2 tsp black pepper1 lemon, halved1 garlic bulb, halved crossways4 carrots, halved lengthways3 parsnips, quartered2 red onions, quartered2 tbsp olive oil2 tbsp honey1 tbsp plain flour300ml chicken stockHeat the oven to 200°C. Pat the chicken dry, rub with the butter, thyme, salt and pepper and push the lemon halves inside.Toss the carrots, parsnips, onions and garlic with the oil in a roasting tin and sit the chicken on top.Roast for 1 hour.Brush the chicken with the honey and roast until the juices run clear.Rest the chicken on a board and keep the vegetables warm.Stir the flour into the pan juices, whisk in 300ml chicken stock and simmer to a gravy.Carve and serve with the vegetables and gravy.Great hall roast roots with honey and thymeCarrots, parsnips and turnips. Shop smart, shop S-MartHow to make it4 carrots, halved lengthways3 parsnips, halved lengthways2 turnips, cut in wedges3 tbsp olive oil2 tbsp honey4 sprigs of thymeCut the carrots, parsnips and turnips.Toss with the oil and salt and roast at 210°C until browned.Drizzle with honey, add the thyme and roast until sticky.SweetsAsh's forgotten words honey cakeSpiced honey and ginger loaf cake with toasted almonds, a honey drizzle and thick creamHow to make it250g honey, for the cake125g butter100g brown sugar2 eggs125ml milk250g self-raising flour2 tsp ground ginger1 tsp ground cinnamon1/4 tsp ground cloves40g flaked almonds2 tbsp honey, for drizzling200ml thick creamHeat the oven to 170°C and grease and line a loaf tin.Melt 250g honey with the butter and brown sugar and cool a little.Whisk in the eggs and milk, then fold in the flour, ginger, cinnamon and cloves.Pour into the tin and scatter with the almonds.Bake until a skewer comes out clean.Cool in the tin.Drizzle with the extra honey and serve in thick slices with the cream.DrinksHenry the Red's spiced mead punchMead warmed with cloudy apple juice, orange, ginger, cinnamon and cloves, served in heavy mugsHow to make it750ml mead500ml cloudy apple juice1 orange, sliced2 cinnamon sticks6 whole cloves4 slices of fresh ginger2 tbsp honeyPut everything in a pot and warm gently without letting it boil.Take off the heat and leave to steep.Ladle into 4 heavy mugs with a slice of orange in each.Mulled ale with nutmegKlaatu, barada, nik... ask the barmaid.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
